intent.proves: The buyer persona TruvioBuyer exists as exactly one sign-in (login) row.
intent.scope: AccessUser rows with the user name TruvioBuyer that are the login of that user name (AccessUserIsLogin); the sample data also ships a second, non-login row under the name

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AccessUser WHERE AccessUserUserName = N'TruvioBuyer' AND AccessUserIsLogin = 1
